endpoints.direct_births: D: number of birth events whose parent is focal, through H inclusive
endpoints.lineage_births: L: all unique descendants born by H; excludes focal, includes direct children
endpoints.deeper_births: R=L-D: grandchildren and deeper descendants born by H
endpoints.living_descendants: S: descendants present with HP>0 at end of H; excludes focal
endpoints.present_hp_nonpositive_descendants: P: descendants present with HP<=0 pending removal; not living
endpoints.dead_focal: continue descendants through H; never censor the lineage at focal removal
endpoints.extinction: retain all arms; D/L retained, S=0; no survival/exposure conditioning
endpoints.aggregation_unit: seed; never individual, descendant or generation

inference.zero_sample_variance: CI/precision not estimable; report values and no confirmation claim
inference.minimum_effect_supported: only if lower_CI(I)>=0.2; point estimate alone does not establish minimum effect
inference.secondary_claims: prespecified_exploratory; no confirmatory claim from unadjusted secondary intervals
inference.rare_or_skewed_data: report all 32 contrasts/sign counts; t interval is approximate; no sparse-data certainty

logging.births: all herbivore parent/child IDs, tick, A/B birth resistance; gzip JSONL
logging.removals: all herbivore IDs, tick, removal trigger and terminal focal birth counter; gzip JSONL
logging.snapshots: all present herbivore IDs/HP at 3000 and 6000; focal/lineage aggregates every 100 ticks
logging.physiology: focal doses/damage/prevented damage/paid upkeep and birth gates accumulated online
logging.causal_death: not inferred from removal trigger; first HP0/attack only with explicit phase, missing=null
logging.provenance: commit + dirty/untracked status + full source/tool/config/binary/protocol/result hashes
logging.manifest_storage: shared immutable manifest once; each arm references its hash; avoid per-arm duplication

quality.conservation: existing per-tick absolute 1e-3 / relative 1e-9 checks, unchanged

execution_limits.infrastructure_failure: retain partial data; no successful-study claim or silent retry; document revised run before restart
